tasks.title: Calculate Centroid Drift
tasks.description: Measure distance between true means and K-Means centroids

requirements: Accept: true_means (list of 3 means), centroids (3×2 array)

subtasks.content:
✅ EXCELLENT CLUSTERING
   Silhouette score of {silhouette:.3f} indicates tight, well-separated clusters.
   K-Means successfully identified all three natural groups.
   All centroids are close to true means (max drift: {max_drift:.2f}).

❌ POOR CLUSTERING
   Silhouette score of {silhouette:.3f} indicates significant overlap.
   K-Means struggles when clusters are not well-separated.
   Consider: Are groups too close? Did you explode a group too much?

📍 CENTROID DRIFT DETECTED:
   {group_label}'s K-Means centroid moved {drift:.2f} units from true mean.
   This indicates boundary effects from nearby clusters.

💥 VARIANCE EXPLOSION EFFECT:
   {group_label} was exploded by {scale_factor}×.
   Its points scattered widely, causing misclassifications.
   K-Means minimizes distance, so nearby points from other groups may be captured.
